title: Direct products preserve bentness
statement: Let $n,m$ be even, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ and $g:\mathbb F_2^m\to\mathbb R$ be bent. The function on $\mathbb F_2^{n+m}$ that sends a concatenated pair $(x,y)$ to $f(x)g(y)$ is bent.
